title: Insured Out-of-Pocket Estimates, Variance Review and Closing — Good Faith & Price Estimates
content:
**Insured estimates.** An Insured Patient Out-of-Pocket Estimate under Good Faith & Price Estimates is an informational estimate based on the benefits verified on the issue date; it does not limit what the patient may be billed, and the patient-provider dispute process does not apply to it.

**Variance review.** After any rendered estimated service is billed, when the patient's actual liability exceeds the estimate total by more than the type's variance-review percentage, Patient Financial Services reviews the variance with the patient before the second statement.

**Closing and lapse.** An estimate with no dispute closes once the dispute initiation window in days has passed after the initial bill date; an estimate never used lapses after the type's validity period from its issued date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures, a type with a 15 percent variance-review percentage)

| Estimate total | Actual liability | Excess over the total | Review before the second statement? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2000.00 | 2300.00 | exactly 15 percent | no — the excess is not more than 15 percent |
| 2000.00 | 2300.01 | more than 15 percent | yes |
| 2000.00 | 1800.00 | none | no |

On a type whose variance-review percentage is 0, any excess at all is more than 0 percent and is reviewed.
